children: The upcoming intelligent utility vehicle gets a bold exterior and tech-focused cabin aimed at urban buyers
Hyundai Motor India has unveiled the first design sketches of its upcoming sport utility vehicle (SUV), Bayon, giving a first look at the model’s exterior and interior ahead of its launch.

The Bayon is being developed as a global product and is positioned by Hyundai as an Intelligent Utility Vehicle. The company says the model combines a stronger SUV identity with features aimed at everyday urban driving.

The sketches showcase Hyundai’s evolving ‘Art of Steel’ design language, with sculpted surfaces, sharp character lines and pronounced proportions. The front design features a sculpted bonnet, prominent fenders and Hyundai’s H-Edge lighting signature, along with robust lower body elements.

According to Hyundai, the design is intended to give Bayon a confident and youthful appearance while retaining the practicality needed for city use. The company has focused on defined surfaces and architectural proportions to create a more distinctive SUV profile.

The interior sketch offers a first look at the cabin, although Hyundai has not yet disclosed specific equipment or specifications. The company says the cabin will focus on technology, connectivity and intuitive interactions, with a layout designed around contemporary urban lifestyles.

The vehicle’s design is intended to balance a high-tech cabin with a tougher exterior, with elements such as the sculpted bonnet, bold fender volumes and H-Edge lighting forming key parts of its identity.
